scientific_integrity: Analytic exact primal-dual certificates; a standalone checker provides supporting finite rational and spectral examples. No independent validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: Square invertible real unit-row systems; the inverse row Gram must exhibit a homogeneous complete-bipartite positive off-diagonal block and exactly one negative within-part pair. Conditional one-step expected squared-error contraction only. The normalized-row realizability condition is not waived. No adaptive, block, multistep, or rectangular claims.
title: Exact two-phase Kaczmarz sampling for a bipartite inverse Gram with one antagonistic pair
